outcome: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) in pregnancy
cohort: The study included 401,470 South Korean women who delivered between January 2010 and December 2014, including 459 pregnant women with SSNHL and 401,011 without SSNHL.
finding: Pre-pregnancy obesity was associated with an increased risk of sudden sensorineural hearing loss during pregnancy (adjusted odds ratio 1.52).
mod_finding: No statistically significant differences were observed in the method of delivery between pregnant women with and without SSNHL.
